GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiShape class.

GetContent.description: Returns the shape inner contents where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.

GetDocContent.description: Returns the shape inner contents where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.

GetGeometry.description: Returns the geometry object from the current shape.

GetLine.description: Gets the outline properties from the current shape.

GetParentSheet.description: Returns the parent sheet of the current drawing.

GetVerticalTextAlign.description: Gets the vertical alignment from the shape content where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.

SetGeometry.description: Sets a custom geometry for the current shape.

SetLine.description: Sets the outline properties to the current shape.

params.description: The stroke used to create the shape outline.
params.name: oStroke

returns.description: returns false if param is invalid.

SetPaddings.description: Sets the text paddings to the current shape.
SetPaddings.signature: SetPaddings(nLeft: EMU, nTop: EMU, nRight: EMU, nBottom: EMU): boolean

SetVerticalTextAlign.description: Sets the vertical alignment to the shape content where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.

params.description: The vertical alignment type for the shape inner contents.
params.name: verticalAlign

returns.description: returns false if shape or aligment doesn't exist.
